title: Ordinary thought has a quantum mode and a classical mode

statements.text: Ordinary thought runs in two Turing-computable modes: a very fast quantum mode, mostly unconscious, whose logic is the logic of qubits, and a conscious classical mode that arises from its decoherence, whose logic is Basic Logic.

sources.quote: The classical mode concerns those mental processes, which humans are aware of. It arises from the decoherence of the quantum computational state
